46/G.goal: Explain how to design and analyze an empirical user study for evaluating an XR system.
46/G.achieves: This supports the course aim of implementing an XR system with confidence by giving the learner a method for evidence-based evaluation of the system.

46/O1.goal: Explain how to design a controlled empirical user study for an XR system.
46/O1.achieves: This gives the learner the basis for collecting representative, well-controlled user evidence during implementation of an XR system.

46/O2.goal: Explain how to analyze empirical user-study data by selecting an appropriate statistical test and determining whether observed differences are statistically significant.
46/O2.achieves: This lets the learner judge whether observed XR interface differences are meaningful, supporting data-backed implementation decisions and later optimization.
